components.name: Primary Auth Button
components.description: Full-width cobalt primary CTA that deepens on hover to maintain high white-text contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #1677ff; color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(9 88 217 / 22%), 0 6px 16px -4px rgb(22 119 255 / 34%); transition: background-color 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.14s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0e65e5; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(9 88 217 / 26%), 0 10px 22px -6px rgb(14 101 229 / 44%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0958d9; transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(9 88 217 / 20%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1677ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Recessed Text Input
components.description: 44px touch-ready form field with Recessed Ice resting surface that brightens to Paper White on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { color: #334155; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #d8e2f0; border-radius: 8px; background: #f8fafd; color: #0f172a; caret-color: #1677ff; font-size: 14px; transition: background-color 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input:hover { background: #ffffff; border-color: #9ec2f7; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; background: #ffffff; border-color: #1677ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(22 119 255 / 14%); }

components.name: Elevated Auth Card
components.description: Pure white floating card using single-declaration two-part atmospheric shadow without a ghost border.
components.html:
登录礼簿

登录账号，继续记录往来。
components.css: .ds-auth-card { width: 100%; max-width: 456px; padding: 36px 40px 24px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgb(15 35 66 / 7%), 0 22px 52px -14px rgb(15 35 66 / 14%); } .ds-auth-title { margin: 0; color: #0f172a; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-auth-desc { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #526277; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Language Toggle Pill
components.description: Direct one-click bilingual switcher pill without misleading dropdown affordances.
components.css: .ds-lang-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgb(15 23 42 / 8%); border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 80%); color: #334155; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-lang-pill:hover, .ds-lang-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; color: #1677ff; background: #ffffff; border-color: rgb(22 119 255 / 26%); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -4px rgb(15 35 66 / 14%); }

components.name: Inline Captcha Control
components.description: 10px-gapped tabular verification input paired with a 132px clickable refresh frame.
components.css: .ds-captcha-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-captcha-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #d8e2f0; border-radius: 8px; background: #f8fafd; color: #0f172a; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-captcha-input:focus { outline: none; background: #ffffff; border-color: #1677ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(22 119 255 / 14%); } .ds-captcha-btn { flex: 0 0 132px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid #d8e2f0; border-radius: 8px; background: #eef4fc; color: #1677ff; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-captcha-btn:hover { background: #ffffff; border-color: #9ec2f7; } .ds-captcha-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1677ff; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #1677ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(22 119 255 / 14%); }

narrative.overview:
This visual system unifies the entry experience of 在线礼簿 with its Ant Design administration workbench through a calm, high-key blue-and-white language calibrated to Stripe and Linear light-mode craftsmanship. Because hosts and family bookkeepers open the ledger across every Chinese life milestone—from weddings and birthdays to solemn memorials—the shared entry deliberately refuses occasion-biased ornament, gloomy muted greens, and noisy gradients in favor of luminous optical clarity.

Structure and restraint lead every decision. A bright alabaster spatial canvas with diffused glacier-blue light ribbons holds the perimeter while pure white working surfaces sit cleanly above it through calibrated two-part atmospheric shadows. Blue-tinted slate neutrals, crisp 44px touch-ready form controls, and deepened sapphire interaction states create quiet authority without visual fatigue.
keyCharacteristics: Seamless #1677ff primary continuity between authentication entry and the Ant Design admin console
Blue-tinted slate neutrals across typography, borders, and recessed inputs rather than lifeless raw grays
Single-declaration elevation using soft two-part shadows with zero ghost double borders
Purposeful micro-interactions with exponential ease-out timing and full reduced-motion compliance
Themed browser-native surfaces including selection tint, caret color, autofill preservation, focus rings, and tabular numerals

rules.name: The Deepening Hover Rule
rules.body: Primary blue controls must darken toward Sapphire Hover (#0e65e5) on hover rather than lightening toward pale sky tones, preserving WCAG AA white-text contrast in every interactive state.

rules.name: The Footer Veil Rule
rules.body: Text laid over full-bleed light artwork uses Slate Label (#334155) backed by a subtle transparent-to-Alabaster Ground bottom gradient veil so light ribbons or creases never reduce contrast below 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Tabular Verification Rule
rules.body: Verification code inputs, email OTP fields, and resend countdown buttons apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so numbers align cleanly and countdown text never jitters horizontally.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Elevated cards announce height through a two-part offset-and-blur shadow without an extra 1px border ring; recessed inputs reverse the logic with subtle tonal fill and hairline border.

dos: Do keep primary interactions anchored to #1677ff → #0e65e5 → #0958d9 so authentication flows seamlessly into the Ant Design admin workspace.
Do enforce >= 44px touch targets on all mobile interactive elements (<= 48rem), including utility pills, checkboxes, and text links.
Do preserve 10px horizontal gaps across stacked inline control rows (graphic captcha and email code) so right input edges align cleanly.
Do theme native browser affordances (::selection, caret-color, :focus-visible, :-webkit-autofill, scrollbar-color, tabular-nums) from the palette.
donts: Don't introduce occasion-specific wedding red/gold or funeral olive-green styling on shared authentication surfaces.
Don't stack a 1px border or zero-blur 0 0 0 1px ring onto an elevated card that already carries a wide soft shadow.
Don't use lighter pale-blue hover fills (#4096ff) on white-text primary buttons where contrast drops below 4.5:1.
Don't add decorative chevrons to direct-toggle buttons or show configuration retry buttons after ordinary credential errors.
